action.message: Implemented the fix in src/dotenv/main.py only. In set_key's quoted branch (lines 184-187), backslashes are now escaped before apostrophes: `value_to_set.replace("\\", "\\\\").replace("'", "\\'")`. This matches the parser's single-quote escape set (`\\`, `\'`), so literal backslashes — including consecutive ones and those adjacent to apostrophes — round-trip correctly through dotenv_values(interpolate=False). The quote_mode selection logic and export handling are unchanged, preserving all other public behavior. No tests, docs, other modules, or dependencies were modified.
